source: generic template: the most common channel layout for this class of light. Check your light's manual: if the channel order differs, copy this file or build one with `python3 lighting/dj.py fixtures new`.
notes: Each segment is one head: chases and spreads run along the bar. Many bars also have a dimmer/strobe mode with more channels; pick the pure RGB-per-segment mode on the unit.
